scope: Four remaining physical sites in frozen CL2 exact-Diocesan source-label cohort; source label is not an independently certified ownership claim
photo_search_policy: BLOCK photographs until correct building identity and independently sourced site coordinates are established; no inferred town, street, adjacent memorial or parent church substitutes

items.name: Kościół Świętego Jana Pawła II
items.site: Dyrdy, ul. ks. Jana Antosza 1, Woźniki
items.known_reference: Dyrdy's filial St John Paul II church is at ul. ks. Jana Antosza 1. The source point 50.574894,18.985690 identifies the papal oak adjacent to the church—not a verified church footprint.
items.not_acceptable_as_pin: The adjacent papal oak is not the exact church building; the 1875 Marian chapel on Piaskowa is a different worship site

items.name: Capela da Santa Casa de Santo Amaro
items.site: Avenida Adolfo Pinheiro 235, Santo Amaro, São Paulo, SP
items.known_reference: Diocesan parish, Waze and local history identify the chapel at Av. Adolfo Pinheiro 235. GeoNames identifies the Santa Casa hospital complex at -23.65022,-46.70524, but does not identify the chapel footprint.
items.not_acceptable_as_pin: Do not substitute the geographically separate diocesan parish at Rua Artur Nascimento Júnior 95, nor the metro station beside the chapel

candidate_nearby_only.feature: Santa Casa hospital complex; NOT chapel pin

items.name: Kaplnka Svätej Terézie z Lisieux
items.known_reference: Source labels Kaplnka sv. Terézie z Lisieux on Komenského, Poprad, but the same entry claims Trnava diocese and links Beckov parish. No confirmed chapel building or street number; Komenského 5 in Poprad is a street address only, not corroborated as chapel.
items.not_acceptable_as_pin: Do not substitute different St Thérèse chapels in Vyšné Hágy, Hranovnica, Prievidza or other Slovak localities before identity reconciliation

items.name: Kaplica Świętej Barbary przy parafii Świętego Krzyża
items.known_reference: The city/parish give Holy Cross church at Jaskółcza 37. Historic accounts and local church inventory identify Saint Barbara chapel on the same Jaskółcza 37 site; CL2's Jaskółcza 35 is probably stale or imprecise.
items.not_acceptable_as_pin: Do not substitute Holy Cross church's building pin or its Jaskółcza 37 postal coordinate for the Saint Barbara chapel
items.address_correction_candidate: Jaskółcza 37, Zabrze — complex-level address, chapel footprint not independently determined

candidate_nearby_only.feature: Holy Cross church; NOT distinct St Barbara chapel pin
